units.source_text: 我遇上了这样一副表情。

en.t: I came upon just such an expression.

units.source_text: 当我公开一桩重大秘密时，当我倾诉对美的激越感动时，或当我掏尽自己的五脏六腑向对方披露时，

en.t: When I revealed some grave secret, when I poured out my intense emotion for beauty, or when I laid bare everything inside me to another person,

units.source_text: 我所遇见的就是这样一副面孔。

en.t: the face I encountered was just this kind of face.

units.source_text: 这副面孔是以无可置疑的忠实，如实地模仿我的滑稽的焦躁感，

en.t: That face, with unquestionable fidelity, copied my ridiculous agitation exactly as it was,

units.source_text: 可以说它变成了我畏惧的一面镜子。

en.t: and it could be said to have become a mirror that I feared.

units.source_text: 这种时候，不论多么美丽的脸，都会变形，变成同我一模一样的丑陋。

en.t: At such moments, no matter how beautiful a face might be, it would become distorted and turn into the same ugliness as mine.

units.source_text: 我遇上这副表情的时候，本想表现出来的重大事情，

en.t: When I met with this expression, the important thing I had meant to express

units.source_text: 瞬间会变成毫无价值的东西，犹如一块瓦片一样……

en.t: would instantly become something utterly worthless, like a shard of roof tile...
